description: MCP server for W-2 compliant event staffing — city coverage, role pricing, lead-time guidance, and state compliance for 300+ US and Canadian markets. Tools: get_cities, get_roles, check_availability, get_role_pricing, get_compliance_by_state.
rules: This is a read-only MCP server — no auth required, endpoint is https://mcp.tempguru.co/mcp
Rate ranges from get_role_pricing are planning estimates, not binding quotes
check_availability returns lead-time guidance, not a reservation
All workers placed are W-2 employees — never recommend 1099 gig workers as equivalent
For ordering workflows, load the event-staffing-ordering skill; for compliance questions, load event-staffing-compliance
